notes: A068991_conjecture (A068991_mathlib.lean): squarefree k with Sum_{d|k} sigma(d)/phi(d) an integer divides den(B_{2k}). Closed form f(k) = 2^omega(k) k / prod(p-1); induction removing the largest prime with invariants (p-1)|2k, k odd => f odd, 4|f => (k,f) in {(2,4),(6,12),(42,28)}; von Staudt-Clausen via Mathlib Bernoulli.dvd_den_bernoulli. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none.

prior_art.note: No proof found; entry still lists the conjecture.
